materialization: Create a unique server-backed Space, a Form, one parameterized Saved SQL query, 100 rows for its first result page, one row for its second page, and one row excluded by the date range. The Browser creates the Composition through Save as tool.
space: Create a unique server-backed Space for each Playwright run.

saved_sql.name: Golden monthly rows
saved_sql.sql_template: SELECT {date_column} AS transaction_date, {merchant_column} AS merchant, {amount_column} AS amount FROM {relation} WHERE {date_column} >= $month_start AND {date_column} < $month_end ORDER BY {date_column} ASC, {merchant_column} ASC

variables.name: month_start
variables.description: First date included in this month.

variables.name: month_end
variables.description: First date excluded from this month.

expected.receipt_revision: Must equal the exact revision path opened from Home.

selectors: e2e/composition-golden-journey.test.ts#test:Browser saves a tool once, reopens its exact revision from Home, and pages parameterized results with model connection disabled
